# Copilot Instructions for Managing MD Files

## Task: Organize the numerous MD files generated by the LLM

The workspace contains many Markdown files that are difficult to manage. They appear to be documentation for different aspects of the SixtySeven AI platform, including game specifications, design guides, deployment notes, and more.

## Objective
Create a Python script that:
1. Analyzes all MD files in the root directory
2. Categorizes them based on naming patterns and content
3. Creates appropriate subfolders (e.g., docs/promptforge/, docs/mobile/, docs/deployment/)
4. Moves files into their respective folders
5. Updates any internal links if necessary
6. Generates a new index file showing the organized structure

## Categories to consider:
- PROMPTFORGE_*: docs/promptforge/
- GAME_THEME_*: docs/game-themes/
- MOBILE_*: docs/mobile/
- DEPLOYMENT_*: docs/deployment/
- THEME_*: docs/themes/
- README_*: docs/readme-updates/
- AGENT.md: docs/brand/
- Other general docs: docs/general/

## Requirements:
- Use Python standard library only (no external dependencies)
- Preserve file modification times
- Create folders if they don't exist
- Handle potential naming conflicts
- Provide dry-run mode to preview changes
- Generate a summary of moved files

## Output:
- A complete, runnable Python script
- Comments explaining the logic
- Error handling for file operations
